steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The right to a fair trial (Article 6 ECHR) includes the right to a hearing within a reasonable time, an independent tribunal, the presumption of innocence and the right to legal representation | Key Fact: In criminal cases, Article 6 guarantees the right to examine witnesses and to have the free assistance of an interpreter if needed | Key Fact: The right to jury trial in England and Wales applies to indictable offences tried in the Crown Court, providing lay participation in the justice system | Key Fact: Freedom of expression (Article 10 ECHR) protects the right to hold opinions and to receive and impart information and ideas without interference by public authority
